spells.description: Maokai flings a sapling, which stands watch for seconds. Saplings chase nearby enemies, detonating on arrival to deal magic damage and Slow surrounding enemies by % for seconds. Sap Magic's Cooldown is reduced by an additional 4 seconds if the sapling hits an enemy champion or epic monster. If placed in brush, Saplings instead last for seconds and cause a larger explosion, dealing magic damage over seconds and Slowing enemies by .
